title: Repurpose content with AI: turn one video into many posts
seoTitle: How to repurpose content with AI, step by step
description: Repurpose content with AI: turn one video, podcast or article into posts, clips and emails. Get a repurposing map, three prompts and an accuracy check.
lede: To repurpose content, start from one long piece, pull out its strongest ideas and quotes, and reshape each one for the platform it suits. AI handles the reshaping quickly. This guide gives you the steps, a reusable repurposing map, three prompts and an accuracy check that keeps every piece true.
